related.title: MQTT 5：Receive Maximum 與在途窗口
related.titleEn: MQTT 5: Receive Maximum and in-flight windows
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：由另一學徒只使用交付檔案重建兩情境與判定；需同時保留未通過情境。 教學副作用次數需等於唯一事件數3或5；丟掉所有DUP封包不是驗收策略，因第一次可見副本也可能帶DUP。 mqtt_deliveries.csv、idempotency_ledger.csv與重播證據 保留輸入、逐項中間值、名義 0.5 與變更 0.166667 duplicate fraction、反例、驗收判定與模型限制，供另一學徒從零重算。 附離線證據實驗：python3 tools/curriculum-v28/labs-optical.py --lab comm-v28-201 --out ./comm-v28-201-evidence；輸出目錄必須尚不存在。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: A second apprentice must reconstruct both scenarios and decisions using only the handover files; retain failing cases as well. Teaching side-effect count must equal three or five unique events; dropping everyDUP packet is invalid because the first visible copy may haveDUP set. mqtt_deliveries.csv, idempotency_ledger.csv and replay evidence Preserve inputs, intermediate values, nominal 0.5 and changed 0.166667 duplicate fraction, counterexamples, acceptance decisions and model limits so another apprentice can reproduce them. Offline evidence lab: python3 tools/curriculum-v28/labs-optical.py --lab comm-v28-201 --out ./comm-v28-201-evidence; the output directory must not already exist.
related.difference: 完成兩組條件的可重算判定，指出哪些觀察能區分原因。 教學需求300 messages/s；窗口20的理想上界不足，50只通過窗口必要條件，仍須驗流量與接收能力。
related.differenceEn: Produce reproducible decisions for both configurations and identify observations that discriminate causes. Teaching demand300 messages/s:window20 is insufficient even ideally;50 passes only the window prerequisite and still needs bandwidth/receiver validation.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成收到事件ID[a,b,b,c,c,c]共6筆、唯一3筆；改為[a,b,c,d,e,e]仍6筆、唯一5筆。 名義式 (6-3)/6 = 0.5 duplicate fraction；變更式 (6-5)/6 = 0.166667 duplicate fraction。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 以集合和逐筆idempotency表兩種方法計唯一ID；重播同一檔後業務計數不應再增加。

合成QoS 1窗口20筆、PUBLISH到PUBACK配額釋放時間0.1 s；窗口改50筆，訊息同樣大小且PUBACK可持續。 名義式 20/0.1 = 200 messages/s；變更式 50/0.1 = 500 messages/s。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 建立連續發送/ACK事件表，任一時刻未確認數不得超W；用1秒完成ACK數核對理想上界。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic received event IDs[a,b,b,c,c,c] give six deliveries and three unique events; change to[a,b,c,d,e,e] with five unique events. Nominal (6-3)/6 = 0.5 duplicate fraction; changed (6-5)/6 = 0.166667 duplicate fraction. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Count unique IDs using both a set and a row-by-row idempotency ledger; replaying the same file must not increase business-side counts.

SyntheticQoS1 window20 messages andPUBLISH-to-PUBACK quota-release latency0.1 s; change to50 with equal sizes and sustainedPUBACKs. Nominal 20/0.1 = 200 messages/s; changed 50/0.1 = 500 messages/s. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Build send/ACK events with outstanding count never exceedingW; check ideal one-second acknowledged completions against the bound.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.difference: 建立 offset、length、MF 表，畫出每片涵蓋的半開位元組區間。
related.differenceEn: Construct offset, length and MF columns and draw the half-open byte interval covered by each fragment.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 合成收到事件ID[a,b,b,c,c,c]共6筆、唯一3筆；改為[a,b,c,d,e,e]仍6筆、唯一5筆。 名義式 (6-3)/6 = 0.5 duplicate fraction；變更式 (6-5)/6 = 0.166667 duplicate fraction。逐項標示量綱，先代入未四捨五入數值再作比較。 手算名義式並保存所有中間項，實作下列獨立驗證而非只抄最終數字： 以集合和逐筆idempotency表兩種方法計唯一ID；重播同一檔後業務計數不應再增加。

分片偏移以八位元組為單位；除最後片段外，資料長度須對齊八位元組。
教學基準：ceil(3980/1480) = 3 fragments；對照：ceil(3980/600) = 7 fragments。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Synthetic received event IDs[a,b,b,c,c,c] give six deliveries and three unique events; change to[a,b,c,d,e,e] with five unique events. Nominal (6-3)/6 = 0.5 duplicate fraction; changed (6-5)/6 = 0.166667 duplicate fraction. Label dimensions, substitute unrounded values and only then compare. Calculate the nominal expression with intermediate terms and implement this independent validation rather than copying the final number: Count unique IDs using both a set and a row-by-row idempotency ledger; replaying the same file must not increase business-side counts.

Fragment offsets use eight-octet units; all but the last fragment need eight-octet payload alignment.
Teaching baseline: ceil(3980/1480) = 3 fragments; comparison: ceil(3980/600) = 7 fragments. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
